name: phase-rings
title: Phase Rings
description: A restrained Canvas field of intersecting rings that creates depth behind a quiet foreground.

accessibility.notes: The canvas is decorative and aria-hidden. Reduced motion, offscreen instances, and hidden documents render a static field.

performance.budget: Canvas 2D at 20 fps, at most 66 ring strokes, DPR capped at 1.5 desktop and 1 mobile.
